set.body:
Goal: make Geom.Line ordering an explicit, documented decision.

Evidence: Geom.Line follows row order (path semantics): lineGrobs uses groupInOrder which preserves first-encounter/row order and never sorts by x (CompilerPhases.scala:235-248, 266-281). ggplot2 geom_line sorts by x; geom_path keeps order. Fine either way, but currently implicit.

Acceptance: decide (recommend: keep path semantics for Geom.Line and, when typed geoms grow, add a distinct sorted-line variant if wanted); document the choice in the geom docs/README and assert it in a test so the behavior is pinned; JVM+JS tests.
set.title: Graphics: decide and document Geom.Line ordering (path vs sort-by-x)
